preconditions.description: The input verb must be a string.
The input verb must end with 'ar', 'er', or 'ir'.

postconditions.description: The output must be a dictionary.
The dictionary must contain exactly one key-value pair.
The key of the dictionary must be the original verb.
The value of the dictionary must be a list.
The list must contain exactly six conjugations.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(conjugation, str) for conjugation in return_value[verb])
postconditions.description: Each conjugation in the list must be a string.
The first person singular conjugation must be correct.
The second person singular conjugation must be correct.
The third person singular conjugation must be correct.

postconditions.expression: return_value[verb][3] == verb[:-2] + ('amos' if verb.endswith('ar') else ('emos' if verb.endswith('er') else 'imos'))
postconditions.description: The first person plural conjugation must be correct.

postconditions.expression: return_value[verb][4] == verb[:-2] + ('áis' if verb.endswith('ar') else ('éis' if verb.endswith('er') else 'ís'))
postconditions.description: The second person plural conjugation must be correct.
The third person plural conjugation must be correct.
